translationRules.translatesNeverRedefines: An adapter maps framework behavior onto a native surface. It never changes what a control means, only how it is expressed.
translationRules.noAuthorityOrigination: An adapter never becomes an authority. It cannot approve, cannot classify risk, and cannot resolve a source conflict.
translationRules.noProjectGovernance: An adapter carries no project-specific governance. Project rules live in the Profile, not the adapter.
translationRules.noStateInvention: An adapter may not invent, rename, merge, skip, or reorder a governed lifecycle state or gate.
translationRules.noIndependenceCollapse: An adapter may not collapse required independent steps into one invocation for convenience.

capabilityMap.capability: Defines the boundary all adapters inherit
capabilityMap.translationNote: This is the contract, not an implementation

prohibitions: No adapter may carry project-specific governance
No adapter may invent/rename/merge/skip/reorder states or gates
No adapter may collapse required independent review into one invocation

evidenceTranslation.rule: Every adapter maps framework evidence records onto its native surface without changing evidence semantics. An evidence PASS means the same thing on every surface.

handoffTranslation.rule: Every adapter can express a framework handoff record. Clean-context handoff support is declared, not assumed.

lifecycleSyncRule: Adapters reflect the canonical lifecycle state; they never hold a competing one.
